question: In which year did Mihir Sen create history by being the only man to swim the five oceans in one calendar year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1966**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mihir Sen, an Indian long-distance swimmer, became the first man to swim across the five major oceans within one calendar year in **1966**.
 
• He successfully swam the Palk Strait (India-Sri Lanka), the Strait of Gibraltar (Europe-Africa), the Dardanelles (Turkey), the Bosporus (Turkey), and the Panama Canal (Central America) during this remarkable feat.
 
• This achievement established Mihir Sen as one of the world's most accomplished open-water swimmers and brought global recognition to Indian swimming.
 
• He became the only person to achieve this extraordinary accomplishment in a single calendar year, demonstrating tremendous endurance and resilience.
 
• Mihir Sen was awarded the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan by the Indian government for his outstanding contributions to sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Open-water swimming:** This is a type of swimming conducted in outdoor bodies of water, such as oceans, lakes, and rivers, and requires exceptional physical stamina and mental strength.
 
• **Palk Strait:** A strait between Tamil Nadu in India and the Jaffna District of Sri Lanka, known for its challenging currents and shallow waters.
 
• **Strait of Gibraltar:** A narrow strait that connects the Atlantic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea and separates Europe from Africa, known for its strong tidal currents.
 
• **Panama Canal:** An artificial waterway in Panama that connects the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans, presenting unique challenges for swimmers due to its controlled locks and currents.
 
• Mihir Sen's achievements are often compared to those of global swimming legends, making him a pioneer in Indian sports and a source of inspiration for athletes worldwide.
